ov: The wild pig of Eurasia and North Africa, now one of the widest-ranging mammals in the world after introductions to the Americas and Oceania. Females and young live in family groups.

why.dg: Attacks on people are rare but can be serious, causing deep puncture wounds.

rg: Native to much of Europe, Asia and North Africa; introduced to the Americas and Oceania, where it is often invasive.

cf.tip: The wild boar is the ancestor of most domestic pig breeds.

fx: It probably originated in Southeast Asia and spread across the Old World.
